note: Malleable CT1 -- the coffee table, from 'table ref.3dm'.
Two pieces: the deck loop (a pill, swept along the length) and the leg loop
(a tall loop with a return at each level, swept along the depth).
The design file is one fixed size.  What follows says which of its numbers
are parameters: the leg's head follows the height, the shelf's return
follows the shelf level, the deck's ends follow the depth.  Everything else
is the literal millimetre out of Rhino.
Frames: the page measures the leg from its outer face inward, with the floor
at zero, so offset [-8, 5] lands the extracted curve on it; the deck section
is centred on the piece, so offset [-176, -13].
A rule shifts {u}/{v} rather than replacing it, so every point of a group
keeps its own place within that group: the deck depth of 362 in the file
puts the pill ends at 163, which is LY*0.5 - 18, the bead included.
The top level is rigid to the head in the page (zTop = H - 23.135), which is
the relation the design file already has, so one band anchored to H covers
both the head and the top return.
